tagline: Specializing in the ownership, management, and redevelopment of high-quality retail and mixed-use properties in major coastal markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Occupancy rate of 94.1% reflecting leasing health and tenant demand in owned properties, a key performance indicator in the retail real estate sector.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leased spaces currently occupied by tenants.
kpis.description: An occupancy rate of 94.1% as of end-2025 indicates strong leasing resilience despite macroeconomic pressures.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate despite uncertain economic environment

kpis.name: Leased Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of commercial spaces with an active lease agreement.
kpis.description: As of end-2025, 96.1% of spaces were leased, reflecting efficient leasing management and sustained demand.
kpis.signal: Very high leased rate indicating strong leasing demand

kpis.name: Total Projects
kpis.explanation: Total number of shopping centers and mixed-use projects owned or controlled.
kpis.description: The portfolio includes 104 real estate projects as of end-2025, concentrated in coastal markets with strong fundamentals.
kpis.signal: Stable portfolio of 104 projects primarily in coastal areas

kpis.name: Total Square Footage
kpis.explanation: Total gross leasable area in millions of square feet of owned properties.
kpis.description: The portfolio represents approximately 28.8 million square feet of gross leasable area as of end-2025.
kpis.signal: 28.8 million square feet of gross leasable area

kpis.name: Consecutive Years of Dividend Increases
kpis.explanation: Number of consecutive years of dividend per share increases.
kpis.description: The company has increased its dividends for 58 consecutive years, a record among REITs.

kpis.name: Annual Acquisitions
kpis.explanation: Total value of properties acquired during the year.
kpis.description: The company acquired properties totaling $1.0 billion in 2025.

kpis.name: Installed Solar Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total power capacity of solar installations on owned properties.
kpis.description: The company has 15.3 MW of solar capacity across 28 properties as of end-2025.

kpis.name: Electric Vehicle Charging Stations
kpis.explanation: Total number of operational electric vehicle charging stations.
kpis.description: The company operates approximately 500 EV charging stations across its portfolio, with expansions planned.

risks.title: Lease Revenue Collectibility
risks.score_rationale: This risk is listed first in the risk factors, uses strong language, and has a direct financial impact quantified at $12.5M.

risks.title: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with complex valuation methods (discounted/undiscounted cash flows) and key assumptions (holding period).

risks.title: Impact of Inflation and High Interest Rates
risks.score_rationale: This risk is highlighted as having a current negative impact on interest costs, materials, and operations. It is mentioned in the Outlook section.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions and Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: This risk is noted as potentially causing delays and increased costs for projects and tenant improvements, delaying lease revenues.

risks.title: Tenants' Ability to Pay Rent
risks.score_rationale: This risk is directly tied to tenants' ability to withstand adverse economic conditions, labor issues, or disruptions in their own businesses.

risks.title: Real Estate Acquisition Valuation
risks.score_rationale: This risk relates to the estimation of fair value of assets and liabilities in acquisitions, including leases. Valuation errors could affect future lease revenues.

risks.title: Debt Management and Financial Covenants
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant debt and must comply with financial covenants. While currently in compliance, breach could have severe consequences.

ai_positioning.summary: The company FRT does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
